variant_decisions.evidence: Qere רַגְלָי is 1cs (Ncfdc/Sp1cs), "my feet"; ketiv רגלו is 3ms (Ncfsc/Sp3ms), "his feet"; same lemma 7272. Solomon is quoting his own message about David, so the two readings put the enemies under different men's feet. The ASV reads "until Jehovah put them under the soles of his feet", continuing the third person of David my father ... his God, and no ASV note is mapped to the word. The possessor is visible in the English, so the ketiv is selected.
